name: Room 104
description: An anthology series set in a single hotel room, where every guest who comes to stay reveals a unique set of circumstances and quirks.

videos.title: Ralphie
videos.overview: Things go horribly awry when a babysitter arrives at Room 104 to watch an unusual boy named Ralph.

videos.title: Pizza Boy
videos.overview: A pizza delivery boy gets caught up in a couple’s twisted games.

videos.title: The Knockadoo
videos.overview: A woman seeking salvation is visited by a cult priest promising to help her transcend the ordinary world for another realm.

videos.title: I Knew You Weren't Dead
videos.overview: A visitor in Room 104 seeks advice about his marital troubles from a long-lost friend.

videos.title: The Internet
videos.overview: In 1997, a son must teach his mother how to use the Internet over the phone after leaving behind an important document on his laptop.

videos.title: Voyeurs
videos.overview: The past and present come face to face when a housekeeper reconnects with her younger self.

videos.title: The Missionaries
videos.overview: Two young Mormon missionaries test the boundaries of their faith.

videos.title: Phoenix
videos.overview: In 1969, the sole survivor of a plane crash is faced with a decision: go back to the life she had or seize the opportunity to start anew.

videos.title: Boris
videos.overview: When an aging Croatian tennis player reveals memories of his tortured past to a housekeeper, an unlikely bond is formed.

videos.title: Red Tent
videos.overview: Two young men plotting to disrupt a political convention are interrupted by nerves, and an AC repairman.

videos.title: The Fight
videos.overview: Two female Mixed Martial Arts fighters work together to score a bigger payday in an upcoming bout.

videos.title: My Love
videos.overview: An octogenarian couple returns to Room 104 to relive their first night together.

videos.title: FOMO
videos.overview: Grace and her friends take a weekend trip to celebrate Grace’s 30th birthday, only to be surprised by the arrival of her uninvited sister.

videos.title: Mr. Mulvahill
videos.overview: Jim reunites with Mr. Mulvahill, his third-grade teacher, and challenges him to admit to an incident from the past that left Jim forever changed.

videos.title: Swipe Right
videos.overview: A powerful Russian political technologist arranges an internet first date with a veterinary nurse, who tries to figure out the truth behind his shifting identity.

videos.title: Hungry
videos.overview: Two strangers meet to fulfill an unusual mutual fantasy.

videos.title: Woman in the Wall
videos.overview: Catherine, a woman plagued by a host of ailments, is comforted by a disembodied woman's voice.

videos.title: Arnold
videos.overview: After waking up soaking wet and with no memory of the previous night, Arnold tries to piece together the events that got him to Room 104.

videos.title: The Man and the Baby and the Man
videos.overview: A couple hoping to conceive makes a video of their emotionally-charged night for their future child.

videos.title: A Nightmare
videos.overview: A woman finds herself trapped in increasingly terrifying versions of the same nightmare.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Grieving the death of her father months earlier in Room 104, a young girl returns with her mother in hopes of being able to communicate with him.

videos.title: Artificial
videos.overview: A reporter looks to uncover the truth about a woman who claims to be a hybrid robot warning of an impending artificial intelligence takeover.

videos.title: Shark
videos.overview: A charismatic pool shark tries to convince his reluctant cousin to stay in the hustling game.

videos.title: Josie & Me
videos.overview: A woman asks her slightly-younger self to recreate the events of one night at a college frat party.

videos.title: The Plot
videos.overview: An estranged brother and sister reunite at the site of their future joint investment.

videos.title: Animal for Sale
videos.overview: The caretaker of an exotic animal meets with a woman who'd like to take the temperamental beast off his hands.

videos.title: Itchy
videos.overview: On the advice of his doctor, a man with a chronic skin ailment sequesters himself in hopes that he might finally be cured.

videos.title: Rogue
videos.overview: After running away from home, a teen girl seeks safety in Room 104, where she encounters a woman who offers a glimmer of hope for the future.

videos.title: Drywall Guys
videos.overview: The tale of Greg and Randy, temporary roommates on an out-of-town drywall gig who struggle to find a solution to Randy's sleepwalking problem.

videos.title: A New Song
videos.overview: A singer/songwriter on tour confronts her inner turmoil while composing her next song.

videos.title: Jimmy & Gianni
videos.overview: In this documentary episode, father and son artists Jimmy Ray Flynn and Gianni Arone are invited to create a work of art in Room 104, where they open up about their relationship, their creative process and Gianni's history with addiction and mental illness.

videos.title: No Hospital
videos.overview: An ailing man summons his estranged children to make a change to his will and ensure the line of succession for their extraordinary family business.

videos.title: Prank Call
videos.overview: Left alone by her bickering parents, a bored teenage girl makes a series of prank calls, until one tests her brazen alter-ego.

videos.title: Night Shift
videos.overview: Two stars of a 1970s horror show talk to a podcaster about the origins of their cult TV program and the on-set jealousies that led to the demise of their friendship.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: A young woman sells her soul to live a life of earthly pleasures and is forced to reckon with her decision decades later.

videos.title: The Specimen Collector
videos.overview: While on a layover from collecting a rare botanical specimen, a scientist wakes to find herself inside a lush, rapidly growing jungle. Season three finale.

videos.title: The Murderer
videos.overview: Twentysomething Logan gathers four friends for an intimate performance by the enigmatic, long-lost musician Graham Husker, per Graham’s very specific instructions.

videos.title: Star Time
videos.overview: An unlikely source spurs Sam to confront her history of addiction.

videos.title: Avalanche
videos.overview: With the help of therapeutic dolls, retired pro wrestler Raw Dog Avalanche taps into his memory of an epic bout gone wrong – along with other traumatic, repressed experiences.

videos.title: Bangs
videos.overview: At her divorce party, Eva overhauls her potentially life-changing decision to get bangs.

videos.title: Oh, Harry
videos.overview: A ‘90s family is unwittingly stuck living in Room 104 until dad Harry tries to alter the script on their current reality.

videos.title: The Hikers
videos.overview: Megan and Casey, two college grads embarking on a three-month hike, confront irrevocable truths about their friendship.

videos.title: Foam Party
videos.overview: Hoping to impress his new housemates, perpetually insecure Jack organizes an epic foam party in Room 104, but things get strange when the foam leaves the partiers with a shocking side effect.

videos.title: No Dice
videos.overview: Slick gameshow host Chip Crawford wants nothing more than to keep his meet-and-greet with Enid, his eighty-something biggest fan, as short as possible, but Enid has other plans in store.

videos.title: The Last Man
videos.overview: After failing once again to win a battle against his mortal enemy Durkon, Kyran’s mentor Granada gives him a lesson in vanquishing his foe for good.

videos.title: The Night Babby Dies
videos.overview: When childhood best friends Bruce and Abby meet for the first time in decades, Bruce’s eccentric plan to resurrect their friendship reopens old wounds.

videos.title: Fur
videos.overview: It’s 1987 and friends Finley and Grey crash Room 104 to celebrate their last summer before starting high school, but Grey’s insecurities flare up when popular jock John comes over.

videos.title: Generations
videos.overview: While Keir prepares for his Generations Ceremony, he reflects on his life and relives painful memories of the moments that shaped him.  Series finale.
